column1: # Donkey Kong Bananza (Switch 2, update v458752): Nintendo EPD's engine on NVN2, its shaders Ampere code (the translator's sm_86 frontend).
# Android emulator (arm64, API 35, Vulkan over MoltenVK, 2026-11-03): boots to the title menu, plays the opening and the mining tunnel with sound; all 23,638 shaders
# translate. Open: agl's upscaler network (14a8aaf3e0a9edbd) writes its 2304x1296 output in 8x8 blocks there although its inputs are bound right (DM_VK_TRACE_CS),
# and the emulator draws no geometry shaders (the terrain's culling pass) nor pipelines past Metal's 16 samplers. Not tested on a device yet
